source_limitations: Oxford 3000 and Oxford 5000 official CEFR PDFs directly inspected 2026-10-30. Publisher levels are word/POS only, not independent exact-sense evidence. Eight directly opened dictionary pages provide editorial leads; chronic, insight, transaction and slavery have conflicting PDF/dictionary badges. No human independent review, real audio listening, physical iPhone test or publication. Frozen shortlist and separate reviewer task flags unchanged.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The practice of controlling behaviour to follow rules or achieve goals.

records.editorial_risk: The draft means self-control in learning, not classroom punishment or an academic discipline. Dictionary sense 3 is uncountable self-control; review Burmese register and whether C1 is justified.

dictionary_sense_lead.editorial_interpretation: Sense 3 describes personal self-control; distinct from rule enforcement and academic discipline.
